usedFor: Docsumo reads documents such as pay stubs, invoices and bank statements, and “Folder Creation” sets up a folder for them.

bestTemplate.name: “Folder Creation” in Docsumo
bestTemplate.why: It prepares a folder before documents arrive, which is the one step this app takes from another event.

watchOut: Docsumo offers only “Folder Creation” here, so the reading itself happens inside Docsumo.
